description: This file defines interfaces and a class related to event data generation and control within the Orleans streaming framework, specifically for testing purposes involving Event Hubs. It includes interfaces for data generators, stream control, and counters, as well as an internal implementation of a counter.

classes.name: IntCounter
classes.description: An internal implementation of IIntCounter that provides a simple counter with increment functionality.

methods.name: TryReadEvents
methods.description: Attempts to read a specified maximum number of events, outputting the events if successful.

methods.name: AddDataGeneratorForStream
methods.description: Configures a data generator for a specific stream.

methods.name: StopProducingOnStream
methods.description: Stops data production on a specified stream.

methods.name: SequenceNumberCounter
methods.description: Property to set the sequence number counter for a stream data generator.

methods.name: StreamId
methods.description: Property representing the identity of the stream for the data generator.

methods.name: ShouldProduce
methods.description: Property to set whether the data generator should produce data.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Property returning the current value of the counter.
